description: Declaration of hardware-accelerated PDSCH encoder functions and configuration parameters for 3GPP LTE/5G NR.

classes.name: hw_accelerator_pdsch_enc
classes.description: Abstract class for hardware-accelerated PDSCH encoder with configuration and control methods.

methods.name: reserve_queue
methods.description: Reserves a hardware queue from the accelerator.

methods.name: free_queue
methods.description: Frees a hardware queue from the accelerator.

methods.name: configure_operation
methods.description: Configures the encoding operation with specified parameters and optional CB index.

methods.name: is_cb_mode_supported
methods.description: Checks if CB mode is supported by the encoder.

methods.name: get_max_supported_buff_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size supported in TB mode.
